message.content: {"obligations":[{"id":"EXCHANGE_PROTOCOL","label":"C","source_lines":[46,49,61,66,82,85,97,102],"reason":"Each arm signals its own ready event after depositing/clearing its pad, waits for the peer ready event, and clears the peer event only after the receipt-carrying target move completes (lines 57/93 precede clears at 61/97), then clears its own event; this matches the required reciprocal publish/wait/clear order."},{"id":"EXCHANGE_RECEIPT","label":"C","source_lines":[49,57,61,85,93,97],"reason":"The carried move to the target uses the exact EventReceipt returned by wait_event (peer_ready_receipt) and the corresponding event is cleared with that receipt's version after the move completes."},{"id":"LONG_RANGE_DEPENDENCY","label":"C","source_lines":[49,57,85,93],"reason":"The focal dependency right_ready -> LEFT carried move is implemented: LEFT waits for RIGHT_READY (line 49) and passes that receipt into its carried move to LEFT_TARGET (line 57), preserving the dependency across the intervening control flow."},{"id":"SUPPORT_DEPARTURE","label":"C","source_lines":[41,43,59,63,77,79,95,99],"reason":"Each release is immediately followed in the same coroutine by a same-arm move (LEFT release at 41 then move at 43; LEFT release at 59 then move at 63; RIGHT release at 77 then move at 79; RIGHT release at 95 then move at 99), with no intervening same-arm call."},{"id":"TASK_GOAL","label":"C","source_lines":[35,37,39,41,43,46,49,53,55,57,59,61,63,66,71,73,75,77,79,82,85,89,91,93,95,97,99,102,105],"reason":"The code deposits each part on its own pad, exchanges parts so left_part ends at right_target and right_part at left_target, returns arms to their departure poses, and clears both ready events; no resources are declared, so resource OFF/unowned is vacuous."}]}
